objective: 최신 main 기준 실제 플레이, 문제 수정, 테마별 동일 기준 평가, 평균 90점 이상

prIntegration.scope: Reapplied the six playtest-fix commits onto main after #1041. Currency floor pickup remains intact; no loot, combat or commerce balance changes.
prIntegration.validation: 285/285 smoke checks passed in 47.8 seconds; architecture, CSS and build checks passed after integration.
prIntegration.limitation: The scores and browser evidence below describe the original playtest baseline and fixes. They were not reassessed for the currency floor-pickup change in #1041.

scoring.kind: evidence-backed reviewer assessment, not a measured player satisfaction score
rules: Use the same dimensions and weights before and after fixes.
Score only after the listed representative cases have evidence; untested themes remain null.
Behavior: the intended player action reaches its result without a blocker or extra workaround.
Clarity: current state, available action, result and next step are readable at desktop and phone sizes.
Feel: feedback, pacing and visual consistency assessed during play, with explicit subjective limitations.
Robustness: cancellation, retry, reload, old-save and boundary cases preserve items and progress.
Cost: no avoidable repeated input or observable stalls; performance claims require measurements.
The final average requires all six themes, no known progress/data-loss blocker, and final regression checks.
Early-game or synthetic-fixture results cannot establish late-loop balance or player enjoyment.

themes.name: 전투
cases: melee and ranged natural starter combat
themes.evidence: Natural warrior starter and archer Act 1-10 play, Act 4/9 death and automatic recovery, Act 10 boss at x1. Actual legal T14 melee build equipped shadow blink and a fire wisp through the gem UI, fought the first beehive wave and received 15 pollen; the next wave selection opened. Hit numbers, ailments, enemy HP, summon and movement cooldown were visible. Mobility/summon domain regressions and 24 legal-build later-loop encounters passed.
themes.deductions: Crowded fights still overlap damage labels and enemy bodies; manual off-mode requires more deliberate positioning. Two starter classes and two selected late builds are representative samples, not proof of every skill/class matchup or player enjoyment.

themes.name: 성장·밸런스
cases: representative later loops and legal builds
themes.evidence: Earned equipment/passive changes carried the natural archer through all ten acts and into Chaos 7 at level 42; guest reload preserved progression and the main gem. Desktop/mobile passive allocation, confirmation and cancellation checked. Real unlock purchases spent 2+2 points (15 to 11), first trial completion granted two ascend points and one keystone point, class-selection cancellation preserved the choice, and selecting Warrior then its first node left one point. Refund cancellation and insufficient-currency rejection preserved the node; successful refund accounting and connected-node protection are covered by real-domain smoke tests. Stump gifts, placement and retrieval were exercised in the browser; maturity, resonance, graft scaling and save restoration by domain tests. Selected T14/crafted T15 encounters cover loops 10/30/50.
themes.deductions: Dense build/progression choices still take study. Normal drop-to-build acquisition time, all-class balance and months of economy progression are unmeasured. The short stump UI visit did not itself mature a seed. Those limits prevent treating the synthetic later builds as a complete balance certification.

themes.name: 루팅·거래
cases: offline settlement and reload without duplicate payout
themes.evidence: Natural first loot and equipment reward selection; inventory comparison and balanced/attack/survival recommendation labels. Clicked a distant crate with auto movement off: approached it, broke it and retained manual mode. Opened a golden supply chest: three equipment labels remained beside the open chest, then clicking the label collected the complete pile once (rare crystal armor and two magic abyss belts). Current main intentionally uses floor pickup, not immediate ownership on opening. A real 1-bud stall purchase was collected once. Separate 4-hour deterministic commerce fixture produced a 24-golden-rule offer; countering 25 caused departure with the listing retained, reset/accept produced 24 proceeds, collection disabled the collect button, and mobile rejection retained the item without payout. Floor/save/overflow/protection/offline/negotiation duplicate-payout cases passed in the full suite.
themes.deductions: Many inventory items and long affix text require filtering/scrolling. Floor labels can overlap during combat; collecting while manual movement is off takes a click. The four-hour offer fixture compresses commerce time and does not establish long-term economy balance.

themes.name: 탐험
themes.evidence: Natural progression visited all ten acts and their boss gates; minimap, expanded map, full exploration and keyboard manual movement were exercised. Manual chest/crate approaches preserve the movement mode, ordinary chests remain unopened during auto movement, and floor pickup has a visible result. Real atlas entry/combat, first trial completion, beehive wave reward, Chaos/deep Chaos, sky-tower entry/combat, and ocean depth/oxygen/checkpoint return exercised representative later routes. Ocean reached beyond 100m and returned with a 100m restart point. Desktop overview reopening after closing, focus above another window and mobile 390px overview (389px client/scroll width) checked.
themes.deductions: Some small objects are briefly hidden under the target HUD, though repositioning reveals them; dense map art and overlapping loot remain less clear than empty areas. Later destination checks establish routing and representative progress, not every floor or optional encounter.

themes.name: UI·가시성
themes.evidence: Actual desktop/390px equipment, skill gems, passive confirmation and stump controls; both breakpoint directions, closed-window state, maximize/restore and Escape; natural story and death reports; combat log height 336px to 27.2px when collapsed. Recommendation labels checked with nine real fixture items (two survival improvements).
themes.deductions: Some long item/support labels truncate at narrow widths; the full tree and dense crafting panels still require deliberate scrolling. This is a reviewer assessment, not a player usability survey.

themes.name: 안정성·성능
cases: measured busy combat and window interaction
themes.evidence: Fresh warrior/archer sessions and guest reload at level 29 after Act 10; real combat resumed in Chaos 1 with the equipped skill. Current full smoke, architecture, CSS and build checks plus legal-build save round trips. Ten-second browser combat samples, separate offline replay and stall timing reports. No errors/warnings in the resumed natural session; the isolated fixture intentionally omits Supabase.
themes.deductions: Desktop hardware only; no physical low-end phone or exhaustive worst-case render-load coverage. Three-minute endgame offline replay took about 6.1 seconds in Node with yielding; elapsed time is not a browser frame-time guarantee.

Natural drops and earned passive points progressed through all ten acts. Act 10 boss cleared at level 29 at x1; guest reload preserved level/progression and resumed real Chaos 1 combat. This single route is not optimized-build or all-class balance evidence.

Resetting the fixture and accepting led to 24 proceeds, collection and a disabled empty collection button. Resetting on 390px phone and rejecting preserved the listing. Price input label's missing closing parenthesis fixed.

Distant crate and golden supply chest approached by explicit clicks in manual mode. Chest left one rare crystal armor and two magic abyss belts on the floor; clicking the label produced exactly three acquisition messages and removed the pile control. Reloaded latest source, closed/reopened the exploration map, entered sky tower and fought, then dived past 100m; surfacing retained a 100m checkpoint and restored oxygen. All were actual UI actions, with no game-state mutation through browser evaluation.

sessions.mode: same natural guest save; final reload at x1; no granted levels/items
sessions.observed: Continued to level 42 in Chaos 7. Reloaded the final source, continued from the device save, confirmed level/progression and the equipped gem persisted, then reached level 43. The naturally levelled barrage gem showed Lv.16, 110% damage multiplier, 156% attack-speed multiplier and five projectiles. No console errors in the resumed session.

findings.state: corrected wording to 씨앗·수액 각 1개; no reward changes. Actual desktop/390px view and existing starter/placement/save smoke verified.

findings.problem: Stall counteroffer currency label omitted its closing parenthesis.
findings.state: corrected and checked with actual desktop/mobile offers; no commerce rule changes.

legalBuildCombat.validation: Current equipment requirements, connected allocated passives, level-earned point budget and save round-trip stats checked for selected T14 and crafted T15 builds.
legalBuildCombat.result: With unchanged crafted gear, Chaos 20 boss clears rose from 3.6–3.8 seconds at loop 10 to 39.9–40.7 seconds at loop 50. The weaker T14 build failed this boss but cleared the Act 10 boss.
legalBuildCombat.limitation: Direct encounters bypass destination gates; same gear across loops with no additional permanent growth. Not normal-player target times or all-class balance.

reviewLimits: Scores assess representative playability/clarity/feedback/robustness/cost; they are subjective reviewer judgments, not measured customer satisfaction.
No initial six-theme score was established before fixes; do not invent a numerical before/after improvement.
Natural warrior/archer play, controlled late builds, navigation fixtures and domain regressions answer different questions and must not be combined into an all-class balance claim.
Physical low-end mobile hardware, all builds and long-term economy progression were not exhaustively evaluated. These are deductions and future research, not claimed completed tests.
